name: Henan Yangshao Liquor Industry Co., Ltd.
note: Private baijiu maker registered in Mianchi County, Sanmenxia, Henan (formed 2004 out of the restructured former state-owned Yangshao distillery). Company data reported in Chinese press (citing Tianyancha) show chairman Hou Jianguang holds 65.91% and is the actual controller; the other shareholders (Wang Kun, Zhang Jianfeng, Wei Kai, Zhang Hongqin, Zhang Huwen) are all natural persons. No parent found.
